verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs mention general extensibility via apps/actions/marketplace (github-docs-10) and native CI/CD via Actions (github-docs-11), which implies third-party CI/CD tools can be integrated through Marketplace apps and webhooks, but no evidence explicitly confirms connecting external CI/CD systems (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI) as an alternative to native pipelines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of external CI/CD integrations, webhook-based CI triggers, or marketplace listings for specific third-party CI/CD tools, and any hands-on confirmation this works well.
